title: E.T. Whittaker's 1904-1905 papers showing scalar waves are feasible

tellings.quote: fundamental papers of ET Whitaker 1904 1905 a English British mathematician by the name of ET Whitaker writes these two fundamental papers whereby he actually shows that scalar waves non herzian

plain: The claim is that an English mathematician named E.T. Whittaker wrote two key papers in 1904 and 1905 showing that "scalar waves" can exist. These are said to be a type of wave unlike the ordinary radio waves first made by Heinrich Hertz, which is why they are called "non-Hertzian". Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist with patents for unusual craft, sums up the papers himself and also mentions a writer named Tom Bearden. If true, physics would allow forms of energy beyond the ones in ordinary use.
